cases.title: Discard password on Never For This Site selection
cases.description: Verify that the browser discards the password after Never For This Site is selected in the save password dialog box.

cases.title: Attempt credential save after selecting Never For This Site
cases.description: Verify the behavior when attempting to save credentials again for the same site later after previously selecting Never For This Site.

cases.title: Save and present multiple usernames and passwords for a website
cases.description: Verify that when multiple usernames and passwords for a website are saved, those same choices are later available to be presented.

cases.title: Handle maximum number of stored credentials for a single site
cases.description: Verify that the browser correctly stores and presents the maximum boundary limit of multiple usernames and passwords for a single website.

cases.title: Update saved password on password change
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password for a website are saved and later the password is changed, the password manager picks up and updates to the new password.

cases.title: Password change update failure handling
cases.description: Verify the behavior of the password manager when a password change update encounters an abnormal failure or session timeout during the update process.

cases.title: Disable password manager and verify no save prompts and no prefilling
cases.description: Disable the password manager from the preferences panel, then navigate to a login site to verify that the browser no longer asks to save passwords and no longer gets prefilled info on sites.

cases.title: Disable password manager with pre-existing filled fields
cases.description: Disable the password manager in preferences while already on a site with pre-existing filled or prefilled login fields, and verify that subsequent navigation and interactions respect the disabled state.

cases.title: View saved credentials in password manager preferences
cases.description: Save a username and password for a website and verify that this information can be successfully viewed in the password manager through the preferences panel.

cases.title: Remove specific username and password for a site
cases.description: Verify that removing a specific username and password for a given site results in the credentials no longer autofilling on that site and no longer being listed in the password manager.

cases.title: Remove all saved username and password information
cases.description: Verify that removing all saved username and password information results in no autofill on any site and no entries listed in the password manager preferences.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases are clear, distinct, and adequately cover the requirements without introducing unsupported assumptions or blockers.
All test cases directly correspond to the provided requirements without introducing unsupported expected behaviors or untestable conditions. The assessment is complete and no blockers were found.

analysis.analysis: For R-102: Normal scenario includes selecting Never For This Site in the save password dialog box and verifying the password is discarded. Edge scenarios include attempting to save credentials again for the same site later. For R-103: Normal scenario involves saving multiple usernames and passwords for a single website and verifying all choices are presented later. Boundary scenarios include handling the maximum number of stored credentials for a single site. For R-104: Normal scenario involves changing a saved password on a website and verifying the password manager updates to the new password. Abnormal scenarios include password change failures or session timeouts during update. For R-105: Normal scenario involves disabling the password manager in preferences and verifying no save prompts appear and no prefilling occurs. Edge scenarios include pre-existing filled fields when disabling. For R-106: Normal scenario involves saving credentials and viewing them via the password manager preferences panel. For R-107: Normal scenario involves removing a specific username and password for a site and verifying no autofill and no listing in preferences. For R-108: Normal scenario involves removing all saved username and password information and verifying complete erasure from autofill and preferences.
